name: Muck Mátyás — second son named András (b. 1881)
researcher_question: Did Mátyás Muck and his first wife Erzsébet Wolf of Bikács, Tolna, Hungary have a second son named András, baptized about 1881, after their first son András died in infancy in 1873?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 19, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved: true match — the hint record (ARK 1:1:VJRW-GQR/GQY, Hungary Reformed Church Christenings) names father Mátyás Muck and mother Erzsébet Farkas (= Wolf), a second son András baptized 1881, Bikács residence within the Bogyiszló parish.
